category: free one-click file host, retrieval target

free_tier.stated: 2 GB per file, 30-day expiry without a download, no account needed, 50 GB lifetime storage with a free account. There is no paid tier at all.

retention.stated: files expire 30 days after the last download (vendor default), extendable at upload time

egress.terms: No cap published and no paid path to remove one. Users report 200-350 KB/s in practice.

interface_detail: Browser upload and download only; no API.
chaining: A host that cannot be bought, only used, so it composes as a source of a one-off file rather than as part of a retrieval stack.

limits.value: users report 200-350 KB/s; no vendor number

limits_note: The absence of a paid tier is the finding: there is no key to buy, so the host is either usable at its free rate or not usable.
binding_note: 2 GB per file means a 1 TiB month is at least 550 files, and the observed 0.33 MiB/s makes the month 36 days of continuous transfer.

identity_cost.detail: No account is needed to upload or download; a free account only raises storage.

reliability_note: Downloads of a 2 GB file take about two and a half hours at the observed rate; some users report transfers stalling every 10-20 MB.
confidence_note: The vendor page confirms the free-only shape and the 2 GB cap; the rate is a forum report, not a measurement.

evidence.proved: landing page: upload without an account, no premium tier offered
'Workupload has only a free offer'; 2 GB package, 90-day expiry

price_per_tb_month: not applicable: no paid tier exists
notes: Recorded because it is a host the client will meet and it has no key to buy; the free tier is the whole offer.

extras.price_ladder_reported: none: the service sells no premium plan
